Holds hearing controller + next hearing setter in every state.
Kerala and Gujarat bench clerk also holds order data filler (see the ahlmad diagram).

[page load]
allowed_actions, already filtered by this seat's roles:
start, pass_over, end, reschedule, cancel
(+ mark_attendance for the KL / GJ bench clerk)
Same GET /hearings/ with date=. Only a day over
board_max_hearings sends status=, search=, purpose=, ordering=
[Another day picked (read only) or chips, search, sort]
Screen: Today's hearings, Action column / Hearing overview dialog
Typist's ongoing list picks it up
through GET /hearings/current/
[SCHEDULED or PASSED_OVER, dated today]
[Pass over (chevron, today only)]
[Drag rows into a new order]
Screen: Today's hearings, Next hearing column
(when Next hearing entered by = reader, off = typist sets it in the order)
Grey out non-sitting days, show load per purpose
Flows into the typist's order (fields locked there).
GAP: board rows carry no next_hearing, so the column
cannot survive a reload until it is added
Screen: Today's hearings, bulk bar (tick boxes, today only)
END on a SCHEDULED row records start and end together
[Next date and purpose for the selected rows, same dialog]
[board unchanged]
[every few seconds while the screen is open]
